Rashi on Yevamot 28a:10:1.hebrew: כגון דנפלה הך דאינה חמותו ברישא - ואי במייבם לה האיך ברישא, פיישא שנייה, שנאסרה משעת נפילתה [הוי]; הלכך, תו לא מהני לה היתר:
Rashi on Yevamot 28a:10:1.english: Where the one who is not his mother-in-law fell [before them] first - And if that [brother] performs levirate marriage with her first, the second [sister] remains [for the other brother] — [she] is one who was forbidden from the moment she fell; therefore, [subsequent] permissibility no longer avails her.

Rashi on Yevamot 28a:11:1.hebrew: קל היה להן לב"ה - כלומר, ב"ה לקולא אמרי:
Rashi on Yevamot 28a:11:1.english: It was lenient for Beit Hillel - That is to say, Beit Hillel ruled leniently.

Rashi on Yevamot 28a:12:1.hebrew: ר"ש כמאן - אליבא דמאן:
Rashi on Yevamot 28a:12:1.english: Rabbi Shimon [is] in accordance with whom - According to whose [opinion].

Rashi on Yevamot 28a:12:2.hebrew: אי - אתא למימר בית שמאי אומרים יקיימו, היינו ר"א:
Rashi on Yevamot 28a:12:2.english: If - [he] came to say [that] Beit Shammai say they may maintain [the marriage], that is Rabbi Eliezer:

Rashi on Yevamot 28a:12:3.hebrew: ואי אב"ה - קא מסהיד, היינו אבא שאול. והא ליכא למימר דטעמא דנפשיה קאמר, דלאו בר פלוגתייהו דבית שמאי ובית הלל הוא:
Rashi on Yevamot 28a:12:3.english: And if regarding Beit Hillel - [that] he is testifying, that is Abba Shaul. And one cannot say that he is stating his own reasoning, for he is not a disputant of Beit Shammai and Beit Hillel.

Rashi on Yevamot 28a:13:1.hebrew: תנינא חדא זימנא - בפרק כיצד, אחותה של ערוה כשהיא יבמתה או חולצת כו', והיינו נמי אסור בה ומותר באחותה:
Rashi on Yevamot 28a:13:1.english: We have learned [this] once - In the chapter [entitled] Keitzad: "The sister of a forbidden relation, when she is her yevamah, either performs chalitzah, etc.," and this is also [the case of] "he is forbidden to her and permitted to her sister."

Rashi on Yevamot 28a:14:1.hebrew: התם - הוא דליכא אלא חד אחא לקמן, וליכא למיגזר מידי. אבל הכא, דאיכא למיגזר דלמא אתא שני לייבומי כאחיו וקא פגע באחות זקוקתו, דקמי דידיה הוו רמיין תרווייהו — אימא אפילו האי דלא רמיא ערוה קמיה לא לייבם. קא משמע לן:
Rashi on Yevamot 28a:14:1.english: There - it is [a case] where there is only one brother before us, and there is nothing to decree [against]. However, here, where there is [reason] to decree lest the second [brother] come to perform levirate marriage like his brother and [thereby] encounter the sister of his zekukah [the woman bound to him by the levirate bond] — since both of them were cast before him — I would say [that] even this [brother], before whom the forbidden relative was not cast, should not perform levirate marriage. [Therefore,] it teaches us [that he may].

Rashi on Yevamot 28a:15:1.hebrew: דקא מוכח - דמדלא מייבם האי כאחיו, איכא היכירא דאחות זקוקתו אסורה; והאי דייבם האי, משום טעמא דערוה לא רמיא קמיה, ולא אתי למישרי אחות זקוקתו בעלמא:
Rashi on Yevamot 28a:15:1.english: Who indicates - For since this [brother] does not perform levirate marriage like his brother, there is an indication that the sister of one's zekukah [a woman bound by a levirate bond] is forbidden; and [that] this one performs levirate marriage [is] because of the reason of ervah, [that the forbidden relative] does not fall before him [for levirate marriage], and [thus people] will not come to permit the sister of one's zekukah in general.

Rashi on Yevamot 28a:15:2.hebrew: אבל התם - דליכא אלא חד אח, אימא לא לייבם, דלמא אתי למישרי אחות זקוקתו בעלמא:
Rashi on Yevamot 28a:15:2.english: However, there - where there is only one brother, I would say [that] he should not perform levirate marriage, lest [one] come to permit the sister of a woman bound to him by a levirate bond in general.

Rashi on Yevamot 28a:1:1.hebrew: חולצות לכתחלה - משמע, כלומר: אין כאן תקנה אחרת:
Rashi on Yevamot 28a:1:1.english: [They] perform chalitzah ab initio - [This is what] it implies, that is to say, there is no other remedy here.

Rashi on Yevamot 28a:1:2.hebrew: ה"ג ולימא ליה גזירה דלמא קדים וחליץ לראשונה ברישא - אי אמרת להו חלוצו לשניה ויבמו ראשונה, גזירה דלמא קדים חד וחליץ לראשונה, ואתי לייבומי אידך שניה, דסברי: מה איכפת בין זו לזו? אבל בדיעבד, שחלץ לשנייה תחלה, שריא ליה לאידך לייבומי קמייתא; דמאן דחזי דחלץ לשניה ברישא וחזר וייבם קמייתא, אסיק אדעתיה ולא אתי למחלץ לקמייתא ולייבומי שניה:
Rashi on Yevamot 28a:1:2.english: This is the reading: And let him say to him, "A decree lest he proceed and perform chalitzah with the first [sister] first" - If you tell them, "Perform chalitzah with the second [sister] and perform levirate marriage with the first [sister]," [there is] a decree lest one [brother] proceed and perform chalitzah with the first [sister] and another [brother] come to perform levirate marriage with the second [sister], because they think, "What difference is there between this one and that one?" However, after the fact, when he performed chalitzah with the second [sister] first, it is permitted for the other [brother] to perform levirate marriage with the first [sister]; for anyone who sees that he performed chalitzah with the second [sister] first and then performed levirate marriage with the first [sister] takes note [of it] and will not come to perform chalitzah with the first [sister] and levirate marriage with the second [sister].

Rashi on Yevamot 28a:1:3.hebrew: ומשני ולא מתייבמות קתני - דאי נמי חלץ לשניה, אין כאן יבום:
Rashi on Yevamot 28a:1:3.english: And [the Gemara] answers: It teaches, "They may not enter into levirate marriage" - For even if he performed ḥalitza with the second [sister], there is no [law of] levirate marriage here.

Rashi on Yevamot 28a:2:1.hebrew: ולימא ליה גזירה שמא ימות ואסור לבטל מצות יבמין - וה"פ: לימא ליה רבי יוחנן: תנא דמתני', טעמיה לאו משום זיקה קא אסר לייבם ב' אחיות, דס"ל אין זיקה; דאי טעמא משום זיקה, מכי חליץ לשניה ופקע זיקתה, שרי לייבומי ראשונה כדאמרי אנא. אלא טעמא משום שמא ימות, כדאמר בריש פירקין, דלמא אדמייבם חד מיית אידך כו'. ומשו"ה שקול רבנן דין יבום מאחיות לגמרי, ואפילו חלץ לחדא מינייהו, דלא בטלי תו מצות יבמין — כי היכי דלא ירגילו יבום באחיות, ואתי לייבומי לכתחלה קמי חליצה, ואדמייבם חד מיית אידך. אבל לגבי מיתה דלעיל דאיירי בה ר' יוחנן, ליכא למיגזר הכי:
Rashi on Yevamot 28a:2:1.english: And let him say to him: [It is] a decree lest he die, and it is prohibited to negate the mitzva of levirate marriage - And this is its explanation: Let Rabbi Yochanan say to him: The Tanna of the Mishnah — his reason is not because of [the] levirate bond [that] he prohibits performing levirate marriage with two sisters, for he holds there is no levirate bond; for if the reason were because of [the] levirate bond, once he performs chalitzah to the second [sister] and her levirate bond expires, it would be permitted to perform levirate marriage with the first [sister], as I say. Rather, the reason is because of "lest he die," as it was stated at the beginning of our chapter: perhaps while one [brother] is performing levirate marriage, the other will die, etc. And because of this, the Rabbis completely removed the law of levirate marriage from sisters, even if he performed chalitzah to one of them, so that the mitzva of levirate marriage will no longer be negated — so that they do not become accustomed to levirate marriage with sisters, and come to perform levirate marriage initially before chalitzah, and while one performs levirate marriage, the other [brother] dies. However, regarding the [case of] death above that Rabbi Yochanan was discussing, it is not possible to make such a decree.

Rashi on Yevamot 28a:3:1.hebrew: ר' אלעזר היא - בפ' ב"ש (לקמן יבמות קט.), ואנא דאמרי כרבנן:
Rashi on Yevamot 28a:3:1.english: It is Rabbi Elazar - in the chapter [entitled] Beit Shammai (below, Yevamot 109a), and I spoke in accordance with the Rabbis.

Rashi on Yevamot 28a:3:2.hebrew: מדסיפא - דמתני' ר"א, דקתני: ר"א אומר, ב"ש אומרים: יקיימו (כו') ב"ה אומרים: יוציאו:
Rashi on Yevamot 28a:3:2.english: Since the latter clause - [of] the Mishnah [is] Rabbi Eliezer, as it teaches: Rabbi Eliezer says: Beit Shammai say they may keep [them] [etc.], [and] Beit Hillel say they must divorce [them].

Rashi on Yevamot 28a:5:1.hebrew: ולימא ליה - דלא ידעינן הי נפול ברישא, דלימא ליה חלוץ לשניה:
Rashi on Yevamot 28a:5:1.english: And let him say to him - That we do not know which [sister] fell [for levirate marriage] first, so that he could say to him, "Perform chalitzah with the second [sister]."

Rashi on Yevamot 28a:6:1.hebrew: א"ה - דמשום דלא ידעינן הוא, הא אי הוה ידעינן, מתייבמת ראשונה:
Rashi on Yevamot 28a:6:1.english: If so - [meaning] that it is because we do not know, whereas if we had known, the first [sister] would be taken in levirate marriage.

Rashi on Yevamot 28a:6:2.english: This is that which it teaches - That is to say, [regarding] that which it teaches, "they must divorce [them]" — why?

Rashi on Yevamot 28a:6:3.hebrew: בשלמא לראשון אמרי' ליה - אפיק, דודאי באיסורא אתא לידך, דא"נ ראשונה היא, מאן שריא ניהלך? הלא אחות זקוקה היא, ומי מאחיך חלץ לאחותה לאפקועי זיקה מינה? אלא שני, לימא: אחר שייבם ראשון שניה, אירע לחלקו, והויא זו ראשונה יבמה שהותרה ונאסרה וחזרה והותרה. דהכי אמר בפ' כיצד (לעיל יבמות כד.): קדמו וכנסו אין מוציאין מידם, משום דליכא אלא ספק פגע באחות זקוקה; והא נמי לשני ספק הוא:
Rashi on Yevamot 28a:6:3.english: Granted, to the first [brother] we say to him - Send [her] out, for she certainly came into your hand in [a state of] prohibition; for even if she is the first [sister], who permitted her to you? Is she not the sister of a woman bound by a levirate bond, and which of your brothers performed chalitzah for her sister to remove the levirate bond from her? But [as for] the second [brother], let him say: After the first [brother] consummated levirate marriage with the second [sister], [this one] fell to his lot, and this first [sister] is a yevamah who was permitted, and [then] forbidden, and [then] permitted again. For so it says in the chapter [entitled] Keitzad (above, Yevamot 24a): "If they went ahead and married [them], we do not force them to divorce," because there is only a doubt [whether] he encountered the sister of a woman bound by a levirate bond; and this [case] too, for the second [brother], is a doubt.

Rashi on Yevamot 28a:7:1.english: This is what he said to him: "I do not know who taught: Sisters" - For he cannot resolve [the mishnah] in accordance with his teaching at all.

Rashi on Yevamot 28a:8:1.english: Prohibition of a forbidden relative - For example, his mother-in-law or another forbidden relative.

Rashi on Yevamot 28a:8:2.hebrew: דנפלה חמותו ברישא - זו שאסרה את האחרת נפלה תחלה. והאי דנקט חמותו, חדא מעריות נקט, וניחא למינקטיה מילתא דשכיחא, ושאר עריות טריחא מילתא לאשכוחי:
Rashi on Yevamot 28a:8:2.english: That his mother-in-law fell first - The one who forbade the other [sister] fell [for levirate marriage] first. And [as for] the reason [the Gemara] mentioned his mother-in-law: it cited one of the forbidden relatives, and it is convenient to cite a common case, whereas [with] the other forbidden relatives it is difficult to find [such a case].

Rashi on Yevamot 28a:8:3.hebrew: אמאי - שני אסור בשתיהן? ליקו חתן של ראשונה ולייבם לשניה, דאינה חמותו ואינה אחות זקוקה, ותיהוי חמותו לגבי אידך אח יבמה שהותרה בשעת נפילה כו':
Rashi on Yevamot 28a:8:3.english: Why - [is] the second [brother] forbidden to both of them? Let the son-in-law of the first [sister] rise and perform levirate marriage with the second [sister], for she is not his mother-in-law and is not the sister of a woman bound [to him by levirate], and let his mother-in-law be, with respect to the other brother, [like] a yevama who was permitted at the time she fell [before him for levirate marriage], etc.

Tosafot on Yevamot 28a:11:1.hebrew: רבי אליעזר אומר ב"ש אומרים יקיימו - וא"ת: וכי טעמא דב"ש אתא לאשמועינן? דהכי פריך בפרק רבי אליעזר דמילה (שבת דף קלה.). וי"ל: דאיצטריך הכא לאפוקי מברייתא דאבא שאול, דאמר: "קל היה להם לב"ה בדבר זה":
Tosafot on Yevamot 28a:11:1.english: Rabbi Eliezer says: Beit Shammai say they may maintain [them as their wives] - And if you will say: Does [the Tanna] come to teach us the reasoning of Beit Shammai? For so [the Gemara] objects in the chapter [entitled] Rabbi Eliezer DeMilah (Shabbat 135a). And one can say that it was necessary here to exclude the baraita of Abba Shaul, who said: "This was a matter of leniency for Beit Hillel."

Tosafot on Yevamot 28a:3:1.hebrew: ולימא ליה ר"א היא - היינו ר' אלעזר דהחולץ (לקמן יבמות דף מא. ושם), דתני גבי שומרת יבם שקידש אחיו את אחותה: מתה יבמתו — מותר באשתו; מתה אשתו — אותה יבמה חולצת ולא מתייבמת. ובקונטרס פי' דהיינו ר"א בפרק ב"ש (לקמן יבמות דף קט. ושם), דתנן: המגרש את אשתו והחזירה — מותרת לייבם, ור' אלעזר אוסר:
Tosafot on Yevamot 28a:3:1.english: "And let [Rabbi Yochanan] say to him [that this mishna] is [according to] Rabbi Elazar" - This is Rabbi Elazar of [the chapter] HaCholetz (later, Yevamot 41a, and there), where it is taught regarding a yevama awaiting her yavam whose brother betrothed her sister: [If] his yevama died, he is permitted to his wife; [if] his wife died, that yevama performs chalitzah and does not enter into levirate marriage. And in the Kuntres [Rashi] explained that this is Rabbi Elazar in the chapter Beit Shammai (later, Yevamot 109a, and there), where we learned [in a mishna]: [Regarding] one who divorces his wife and remarries her, she is permitted to the yavam, and Rabbi Elazar forbids [her].

Tosafot on Yevamot 28a:4:1.hebrew: לא סתם לן כר' יוסי הגלילי - לר' יוחנן הוא דמסקינן הכי, אבל רב חסדא מוקי מתניתין דשבועת העדות (שבועות לב. ושם) דכפרו שניהם בבת אחת כר' יוסי הגלילי; ור' יוחנן מסיק התם: אפי' תימא רבנן, והיינו לטעמיה דהכא. ובפ"ק דעירובין (דף ה: ד"ה וספק) פירשתי דקיימא לן דבידי אדם אפשר לצמצם; ובידי שמים נמי משמע לרבא דאית ליה פרק בתרא דבכורות (דף ס: ושם) דאפשר לצמצם, גבי יצאו שנים בעשירי, ובפרק בהמה המקשה (חולין ע. ושם) גבי בעיא אם הלכו באברים אחר הרוב, דמוקי לה שיצא חציו ברוב אבר — ואי אמרת דא"א לצמצם, מאי קמיבעיא ליה? דממה נפשך טעון קבורה, דשמא יצא רובו! ואין להאריך כי שם הארכתי:
Tosafot on Yevamot 28a:4:1.english: The tanna did not teach an unattributed [mishna] in accordance with Rabbi Yosei HaGelili - It is according to Rabbi Yochanan that we conclude thus, whereas Rav Chisda establishes the mishna of Shevuat HaEdut (Shevuot 32a, and there [in the Gemara]), where both [witnesses] denied [knowledge of testimony] simultaneously, in accordance with Rabbi Yosei HaGelili; and Rabbi Yochanan concludes there: You may even say [it is in accordance with] the Rabbis — and this follows his reasoning here. And in the first chapter of Eruvin (5b, s.v. VeSafek) I explained that we hold as established [halakha] that through human agency it is possible to be exact; and through Heaven as well, it is implied that Rava holds in the last chapter of Bekhorot (60b, and there [in the Gemara]) that it is possible to be exact, regarding [the case where] two [animals] emerged at the tenth [in tithing], and in the chapter [entitled] Behemah HaMakshah (Chullin 70a, and there [in the Gemara]), regarding the dilemma whether in [the case of] limbs we follow the majority, where he establishes [the dilemma] as [a case where] half of [the fetus] emerged by way of the majority of a limb — for if you say that it is impossible to be exact, what is his dilemma? Either way it requires burial, because perhaps its majority emerged! And there is no need to elaborate, for I have elaborated there.

Tosafot on Yevamot 28a:9:1.hebrew: הך דאין חמותו ברישא - וא"ת: מ"מ תקשה לרב דשרי אפילו שניה? וי"ל: דרב אית ליה אין זיקה, ולא מיתסר אלא משום ביטול מצות יבמין, וגזרינן דלמא מייבם אידך ברישא:
Tosafot on Yevamot 28a:9:1.english: "The one who is not his mother-in-law first" - And if you ask: In any case, [this] poses a difficulty for Rav, who permits even the second [sister]? One can answer: Rav holds [that] there is no levirate bond [zikah], and [she] is only prohibited due to nullifying the mitzvah of levirs, and we decree [that both are prohibited] lest the other [brother] perform levirate marriage first.
